question: How many recall events (not individual product records) has Boston Scientific had for pacemakers (LWP) in total, across all years?
answer:
Boston Scientific has **27 recall events** for pacemakers (LWP) across all years in the recall data. These 27 events cover **110 individual recall records**.

- The search ran with no start-date limit (it defaulted to 1976 through 2026), so it covers all recall records in the database. The overall recall data is not limited to the 2022–2024 report window.
- The most recent events in the results are a software recall starting 2025-08-20 for the ACCOLADE family, e.g. [Z-0079-2026], [Z-0080-2026], and a 2026-03-19 software maintenance release recall [Z-1770-2026]. Several records share one event, which is why 110 records map to 27 events.
- I only listed the 10 most recent records, so I haven't reviewed the older events individually. Their reasons and dates aren't shown here.
